platform_reference.provenance: User report only; no question-level logs

limitations: Selection on exposed old20, including repeated presentation experiments: training score, not independent validation or official PSB prediction.
The same golden, common baseline, two-order judge prompt and arithmetic were retained. All failures and judge errors are preserved; unchanged judgments were not rerolled.
v235 has15/16 exact paid-first-request hash matches for reused generation; one mismatch (S05c) makes it ineligible as strict target evidence. v237 uses strict wire verification.
Oracle diagnostic copies golden answers only to study judge behavior; it is not a product candidate or a ceiling and is never shipped.
Final artifact changes only pure post-review presentation. It replays all62 saved live v230 outputs; no second full live generation of v239 occurred.
Other cohorts use v229 as the comparator, different from the common old20 baseline. Their scores must not be merged.
